verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a Pre-Auth Checkout API that must be called before the payment gateway, implying a real-time, synchronous call path with a documented REST API (signifyd-docs-3, signifyd-docs-18, signifyd-docs-21). However, the evidence never explicitly describes an ML risk score returned synchronously within the Checkout response — the dedicated GetDecision endpoint (signifyd-docs-4) and webhook notifications (signifyd-docs-7, signifyd-docs-8) suggest decisions may be delivered asynchronously rather than embedded in the immediate API response. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a synchronous score field in the Checkout response, and confirmation that authorization is blocked/gated on that synchronous score rather than a follow-up decision call/webhook.
